mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CTP.PERIOD_NAME AS "PERIOD_NAME", CTP.PERIOD_NAME_LANG AS "PERIOD_NAME_LANG", CTP.CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_ID AS "CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_ID" FROM TIMESHEET TM INNER JOIN TS_BY_USER_LOGIN TU ON TU.TIMESHEET_ID = TM.TIMESHEET_ID AND TU.USER_LOGIN_ID = #{userLoginId} INNER JOIN WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_PERIOD PDO ON PDO.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_PERIOD_ID = TM.WORK_EFFORT_TYPE_PERIOD_ID INNER JOIN CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD CTP ON CTP.CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_ID = PDO.CUSTOM_TIME_PERIOD_ID
